findings.title: Deferred finish on endPreviewPanelControl may misfire
findings.message: endPreviewPanelControl fires for normal transitions, including cleanup's own updateController, and also when the session is being torn down. The deferred block finishes the session with status 1 (cancel) whenever the controller isn't self. It can race with a legitimate flow, and is also executed after cleanup has nil'ed self.panel; the block captures the panel strongly, but cleanup/finish are idempotent only via the finished flag. Status 1 may be misreported as caller cancellation.
findings.suggestion: Use a dedicated status code for lost control instead of 1, and verify the session is still vellumPreviewSession before finishing. Test the hand-back case.
